_comment: Tier-2 Mann-Kendall on a windowed series. Step 1: GROUP_DATE(period) + AGG_AVERAGE bucket revenue by day. Step 2: WIN_MOVING_AVG over a 7-day frame smooths the series. Step 3: TEST_TREND in post_tests detects monotonic drift in the smoothed signal — pairing a windowing step with a trend test is the common analyst pattern for noisy time series.
